resourceType.description: This must be set to 'Appointment' to conform with the FHIR Appointment resource specification.

identifier.description: A list of identifiers associated with the appointment, such as an ID from the source system.

status.description: The overall status of the appointment, such as 'booked' or 'cancelled'.

serviceType.description: The specific type of appointment being booked, such as 'Initial Screening'.

start.description: The start date and time of the appointment, in full ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2025-04-28T09:30:00+00:00).

extension.description: Extensions to the Appointment resource, used to capture custom attributes such as who booked the appointment.

meta.description: Metadata about the resource, including extensions like bookedBy and holdingClinicIndicator.

episodeOfCare.description: Reference to the episode of care that this appointment is associated with.

managingEntity.description: Reference to the organization or group managing the appointment.

location.description: The location(s) where the appointment will occur, as references to contained or external resources.

contained.description: Resources that are referenced from this appointment but are included inline (e.g., a Location resource).
